headword: {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}
gloss: drawing power; ability to attract customers

definitions.gloss: drawing power; ability to attract customers; crowd-pulling ability
definitions.explanation: The capacity of a business, event, location, or person to attract large numbers of customers or visitors. A key metric in marketing and business planning.

examples.japanese: このイベントは{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}がある。
examples.english: This event has strong drawing power.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{店|みせ}は{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Shops in front of the station have strong customer-drawing power.

examples.japanese: SNSを{活用|かつよう}して{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}を{高|たか}めることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to use social media to increase your ability to attract customers.

notes:
Composed of {集客|しゅうきゃく} (attracting customers) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). A common business and marketing term. The suffix {力|りょく} is productive and attaches to many nouns to express "ability" or "power" in that area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}がある: to have drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}を{高|たか}める: to increase drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}の{向上|こうじょう}: improvement of drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}が{落|お}ちる: to lose drawing power

RELATED WORDS:
- {集客|しゅうきゃく}: attracting customers
- {動員力|どういんりょく}: mobilization power (similar concept for events)
- {吸引力|きゅういんりょく}: attraction, pulling power (more general)
